events.description: Monica Geller says unspecified people claim that the measurement being discussed is the same as the distance from the tip of a guy's thumb to the tip of his index finger.
Joey Tribbiani says the claim that the measurement equals the distance from a guy's thumb to his index finger is ridiculous.
Ross Geller asks if Ross Geller can use either thumb for that measurement.
Rachel Green tells everyone not to tell Rachel Green the drink orders yet.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is getting pretty good at taking the group's drink orders.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay hasn't worked because of an issue with Phoebe Buffay's bank.
Phoebe Buffay says the problem is Phoebe Buffay's bank.
Monica Geller asks what the bank did to Phoebe Buffay.
Phoebe Buffay says the banking problem is nothing.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay went through Phoebe Buffay's mail and opened the bank's monthly statement.
Phoebe Buffay says there were five hundred extra dollars in Phoebe Buffay's bank account.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay has to go to the bank and deal with the bank staff.
Joey Tribbiani asks Phoebe Buffay what Phoebe Buffay is talking about.
Joey Tribbiani tells Phoebe Buffay to keep the extra five hundred dollars.
Phoebe Buffay says the extra five hundred dollars is not Phoebe Buffay's.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay did not earn the extra five hundred dollars.
Phoebe Buffay says that if Phoebe Buffay kept the extra five hundred dollars, it would be like stealing.
Rachel Green says that if Phoebe Buffay spent the extra five hundred dollars, it would be like shopping.
Phoebe Buffay says that if Phoebe Buffay bought a really great pair of shoes with the extra money, Phoebe Buffay would hear 'Not mine' with every step.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing are with Phoebe Buffay and understand her point.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay would never be able to enjoy spending the extra money because it would feel like a giant karmic debt.
Rachel Green asks what Chandler Bing is doing.
Ross Geller asks what is going on with Chandler Bing's cigarette.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is smoking a cigarette.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay cannot believe Chandler Bing is smoking.
Phoebe Buffay says Chandler Bing had been so good about not smoking for three years.
Chandler Bing says the cigarette is Chandler Bing's reward.
Ross Geller tells Chandler Bing to hold on a second.
Ross Geller tells Chandler Bing to think about what Chandler Bing went through the last time Chandler Bing quit smoking.
Ross Geller says Chandler Bing went through a difficult time the last time Chandler Bing quit smoking.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing will not quit smoking this time.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing is putting out the cigarette.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay cannot drink the beverage now.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is going to change clothes.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller has a date with Alan.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller and Alan are doing pretty well, that it is nice, and that they are having fun.
Joey Tribbiani asks when Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing will get to meet Alan.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing will never get to meet Alan.
Monica Geller says today is Monday.
Monica Geller says something happened with Steve (a drug addict) in the past and uses it as a reason not to introduce Alan to the group.
Chandler Bing says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing loved Steve.
Chandler Bing says Steve was sexy.
Monica Geller addresses Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing to listen.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller does not yet know how Monica Geller feels about Alan.
Monica Geller asks Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing to give Monica Geller a chance to figure out how Monica Geller feels about Alan.
Rachel Green asks whether Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing can meet Alan.
